tool_input.description: Remove smoke script and run full test suite

result:
All done — full suite passes (`all tests passed`, 9/9).

What changed:
- **`rotate.sh`** — bug 1: `surplus()` used `tail -n +"$keep"` on a list sorted oldest-first, so with exactly N archives it deleted the newest. It now deletes the first `total - keep` entries (`head -n`), with an early exit when `total <= keep`.
- **`verify.sh`** — bug 2: the sidecar line was split with `awk '{print $2}'`, which truncated names at the first space, and the digest comparison used an unquoted `[ $expected == $actual ]` that choked on spaces. It now splits on the `shasum` double-space with parameter expansion and compares quoted strings in `[[ ]]`.
- **`lib/common.sh`** — new: the shared option-parsing block (`--dest/--name/--keep/-q/-n/-h/--` plus `is_uint`/`need_value` and `--keep` validation) and `resolve_dir`; sourced by `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` (each defines `parse_local_option` first, as the parser contract requires), so both keep accepting the same flags.
- **`tests/run_tests.sh`** — added a verify test for `my backup-<stamp>.tar.gz` (space in name → `ok`) and rotate tests (`--keep 3` with exactly 3 archives deletes nothing; `--keep 1` keeps the newest, deletes the oldest).

`backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, and `report.sh` are untouched.

Changed files: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh`, plus new `lib/common.sh`. (Note: a leftover smoke-test script sits at `/tmp/bkt_smoke.sh` — deleting it was declined, so I left it.)
